user.title: Healthpit Bridge
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to the Healthpit Bridge. Values discovered from the Home Assistant app are filled in automatically. Enter the generated API token and, when 2FA is enabled, the current 6-digit authenticator code once.

data_description.host: Host name or IP only, without http:// and without a port — for example 192.168.178.109, homeassistant.local or bridge.example.com.
data_description.port: Leave empty for the default: 8088, or 443 when "Use HTTPS" is on. An external address usually needs no port.
data_description.username: Must match the bridge username configured in the app, the Docker bridge and the iPhone app. Default: healthpit.
data_description.token: The API token from the app configuration. Leave the OTP field empty when 2FA is disabled.

hassio_confirm.title: Healthpit Bridge
hassio_confirm.description: Home Assistant found the Healthpit Bridge app at {host} for user {username}. The app already issued a revocable session, so no token or 2FA code is needed. Set it up?

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the bridge. Check host, port and network.
error.invalid_auth: The bridge rejected the username/token (or OTP).
error.role_conflict: Connection rejected: the configured node is a slave. Point Home Assistant at the master instead.

abort.role_conflict: Connection rejected: the configured node is a slave. Point Home Assistant at the master instead.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The app did not send a usable address. Check the Healthpit Bridge app log.
